notes.page_account: The continuing letter describes diagrams of manifolds with boundary, with arrows mainly locally trivial fibrations and boundary inclusions. A bracketed qualification allows inclusions among closed strata of an elementary cellular decomposition. It asserts reconstruction by gluing and a canonical description-dévissage of compact moderate spaces, possibly with equisingular stratifications, by finite diagrams of the described kind. It then says constructible sheaves, complexes or n-champs on X can be expressed through the diagram; the sentence continues off the sheet.
notes.author_explicit_uncertainty: No explicit uncertainty formula is written on this sheet. Qualifying phrases include “pour l’essentiel”, “en fait”, “légèrement plus générales”, and “éventuellement”. Reader doubts in this report are not attributed to the author.
notes.page_date_title_evidence: 34 is written at the top centre in the main hand. 179 is an archive pencil number at bottom left. No date or title is present. Main text begins mid-sentence with qui and ends with dont il.
notes.paragraph_evidence: The page is one running paragraph. En d’autres termes follows the sentence stop on the same baseline L15; Quand follows à bord. on L21. Neither establishes a new paragraph by physical layout.
notes.math_triggered_reading_decisions: No mathematical repair was made. The recurring partition letter was inspected at both occurrences before applying a common alphabet. The accented adjective ending and plural-looking élémentaires are retained as ink problems even where grammar might suggest a choice. X and n are simple inline symbols; there are no diagrams or displayed formulas on this page.
notes.mathematical_checks: No proof, independent re-proof, computation, formal certificate or mathematical deduction was attempted. The geometric claims are transcribed as source assertions. check_events is empty; visual reading is not claimed as verification.

No coherent isolated nontext stroke was found. Apparent small guide-end dots were not promoted to punctuation.

workflow_feedback: The required whole/top/bottom sequence and once-only crop limit were followed. Eleven distinct crops were saved and successfully inspected once; none was recropped.

The en cellules / i.e. dont / toutes area is one superposed physical locus. The brief correctly allows one crop for its related doubts; the report separates the cancelled wording, live wording and attachment without pretending they are separate visual inspections.

For future packets, specify whether the line-coverage inventory should list the header/archive numbers in the L sequence. Here the 24 main baselines are L1–L24, upper additions use destination-line suffix a, and both numbers are inventoried separately.

The phrase “one crop plus a line of context” can be ambiguous for very small punctuation. Tight strips containing the complete disputed word or mark and local neighbouring ink were used; no half-page enlargement was made.

The 3000-pixel enlargement makes some tiny features large without adding source detail. In particular it cannot decide é versus ée in the L20 ending or disentangle the overwritten L4 article; these remain uncertain.

structural_review.method: Text-only brace, dollar and required-field checks; no TeX engine or rendering invoked.
